in_greek.name: Αρτζελ
in_greek.long_meaning: From the mountain or rocky place, from the Hebrew name חרצל (Hartzel) meaning 'jolting, hurrying, from a rock, hurrying from a rock'

in_latin.long_meaning: Derivative of the Greek name Ἀρτσελ (Artsel), from the Hebrew name חרצל (Hartzel) meaning 'jolting, hurrying, from a rock, hurrying from a rock'
